19009.new_name: Japanese Black and White Lolita Maid Set
19009.desc:
Black-and-white maid styling is the backbone of Japanese cosplay, and this set keeps the formula classic: a soft chiffon dress, a neck ring, and a matching thong, all in the colorway shown. The fabric drapes with very little weight, so the skirt moves when you do instead of sitting stiff.

The Lolita-leaning silhouette works for convention floors, photoshoots, and private role-play alike. Layer it with white knee socks and a curled wig for a full character look, or strip the styling back to the dress alone for something quieter.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: dress, neck ring, thong
  • Style: Japanese maid, black and white
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: M (40-50 kg), L (50-60 kg), XL (60-70 kg)

Check your weight against the chart before ordering - the bodice is cut fitted, and going one size up gives a looser skirt.
19009.short: High-stretch chiffon Lolita maid set in black and white, with dress, neck ring and thong in M to XL.
19009.tkd_title: Japanese Black and White Lolita Maid Set | RoseToys
19009.tkd_desc: Chiffon Lolita maid set in black and white with dress, neck ring and thong. Japanese cosplay styling in M-XL for 40-70 kg, as pictured.

19011.desc:
A one-size campus swimsuit costume in stretch polyester, built for theme nights that value speed over fuss. The set pairs a cropped top with a matching onesie, both in high-elasticity fabric that moves with the body rather than against it.

The styling reads as the classic school swimsuit look, the kind that needs no explanation at a costume party. Between the two colorways, white keeps the retro reference loudest while black reads more understated once the lights go down.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: top, onesie
  • Features: high elasticity
  • Color: white or black
  • Sizing: one size, 85-130 lbs

The 85-130 lbs range is honest rather than optimistic: sitting at the top of it means a close, second-skin fit rather than a relaxed one.
19011.short: High-stretch campus swimsuit costume with cropped top and onesie, one size fitting 85-130 lbs in black or white.
19011.tkd_title: Yes Daddy Campus Swimsuit, 2 Colors | RoseToys
19011.tkd_desc: Yes Daddy campus swimsuit costume in stretch polyester with top and onesie. One size for 85-130 lbs, in black or white.

19012.desc:
The cheongsam is the loudest quiet garment in costume lingerie: a closed collar up top and a high slit waiting below. This retro-cut version is sewn from polyester in two colorways, white and black, with the slit placed to open as you walk rather than as you stand.

Three sizes cover the range. S suits 85-105 lbs, M suits 105-120 lbs, and L suits 120-140 lbs, so pick by weight before anything else - the waist seam is where a wrong size shows first.

  • Material: polyester
  • Item type: cheongsam dress
  • Features: high slits, retro oriental cut
  • Color: white or black
  • Sizing: S / M / L by weight, 85-140 lbs

Wear it with flats for a dinner-costume evening or with heels when the slit should do the talking. Either way the silhouette stays unmistakable.
19012.short: Retro oriental cheongsam in white or black with high slits, sized S to L by weight from 85 to 140 lbs.
19012.tkd_title: Oriental High-Slit Retro Cheongsam, 2 Colors | RoseToys
19012.tkd_desc: Retro polyester cheongsam with high slits in white or black. Sizes S to L for 85-140 lbs, classic oriental costume cut.

19015.new_name: Cobweb Hip Skirt with Thong and Leg Loops
19015.desc:
Halloween lingerie lives or dies on the details, and this set front-loads three of them: a black cobweb hip skirt, a matching thong, and a leg loop that ties the theme together. The mesh webbing is cut to read at a glance, even across a dim room.

Construction is polyester, which keeps the price sane and the care simple. The skirt sits on a 72 cm waistband, the thong stretches from 66 to 120 cm, and the whole set suits roughly 40-60 kg - a range the elastic waist makes forgiving.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: hip skirt, thong, leg loop
  • Style: Halloween cobweb
  • Color: black
  • Sizing: one size, waist 72 cm, thong waist 66-120 cm, 40-60 kg

Pair it with a witch hat for the full costume or wear it on its own when the costume is the point.
19015.short: Black Halloween cobweb hip skirt set with thong and leg loop, one size for 40-60 kg in polyester mesh.
19015.tkd_title: Cobweb Halloween Hip Skirt Set | RoseToys
19015.tkd_desc: Black cobweb Halloween set with hip skirt, thong and leg loop. Polyester mesh, one size for 40-60 kg with 66-120 cm stretch waist.

19021.new_name: Dark Patent Leather Pleated Skirt Set
19021.desc:
Patent leather catches light like nothing else in a costume wardrobe, and this dark set uses it across four pieces: a top, sleeves, a pleated skirt, and leather socks. The finish is uniform, so the outfit reads as one design rather than four purchases.

The pleated skirt carries the silhouette - stiff enough to hold its shape, short enough to keep the look in costume territory. Sleeves and socks extend the shine to the extremities, which is what separates a full set from a skirt-and-top combo.

  • Material: patent leather
  • Includes: top, sleeves, leather skirt, leather socks
  • Style: dark, four-piece set
  • Color: black
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Wipe-clean by nature, which is the quiet advantage of patent leather over fabric costumes. Fits 40-60 kg best.
19021.short: Four-piece dark patent leather set with top, sleeves, pleated skirt and leather socks, one size for 40-60 kg.
19021.tkd_title: Dark Patent Leather Pleated Skirt Set | RoseToys
19021.tkd_desc: Black patent leather four-piece costume with top, sleeves, pleated skirt and leather socks. One size for 40-60 kg, dark styling.

19027.desc:
The sailor suit is the most recognized uniform in costume history, and this navy set plays it straight: a short skirt, the collar trim, and a matching headgear piece to close the look. Colors follow the classic reference, as shown.

It is polyester, which keeps the collar crisp and the skirt flared without any structure needed underneath. The headgear is the piece people forget until they see it in the mirror - it converts a two-piece outfit into a character.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: clothes, headgear
  • Style: sailor / student uniform, navy
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Best worn 40-60 kg. Add white knee socks and the costume is complete without another purchase.
19027.short: Navy sailor uniform costume with headgear and short skirt, polyester, one size for 40-60 kg.
19027.tkd_title: Sexy Sailor Uniform Set, Navy | RoseToys
19027.tkd_desc: Navy polyester sailor uniform set with headgear and short skirt, as pictured. One size fitting 40-60 kg for cosplay and role-play.

19032.desc:
A wedding-night set that skips the gown and keeps the iconography: embroidered roses on white polyester, a veil, a sleeve pair, a leg ring, and a thong. Five pieces in total, each doing one job in the bride look.

The embroidery is the differentiator - printed florals fade into fabric, while stitched roses hold their edges at close range, which is exactly the range that matters here. The veil is short enough to stay out of the way, and the leg ring replaces the garter tradition with something you can actually keep on.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: veil, dress, sleeves, leg ring, thong
  • Style: bride, rose embroidery
  • Color: white
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 45-60 kg

Sized for 45-60 kg. The white-on-white palette means it photographs clean under warm light.
19032.short: White bridal lingerie set with rose embroidery, veil, sleeves, leg ring and thong, one size for 45-60 kg.
19032.tkd_title: Rose Embroidered Bridal Lingerie Set | RoseToys
19032.tkd_desc: White polyester bridal set with rose embroidery, veil, sleeves, leg ring and thong. Five pieces, one size for 45-60 kg.

19038.desc:
December costume calendars run on outfits like this: a bandeau top, a holiday-themed piece, and headgear, all in chiffon and cut to the colorway shown. It is the kind of set that solves a themed night in one purchase.

Chiffon is the right call for this genre - light enough for indoor wear, sheer enough to keep it in lingerie territory rather than costume rental. The bandeau stays put without straps, and the headgear carries the Christmas cue so the outfit does not have to shout it everywhere else.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: clothes, headgear, thong
  • Style: Christmas uniform set
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Fits 40-60 kg. Pull it out the week between Christmas and New Year, when every party has a theme.
19038.short: Chiffon Christmas uniform set with bandeau, headgear and thong, as pictured, one size for 40-60 kg.
19038.tkd_desc: Chiffon Christmas costume set with bandeau top, headgear and thong, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, holiday role-play ready.

19045.desc:
The bunny girl silhouette works because it is a uniform stripped to three signals: the ears, the fitted body, and the accessories. This chiffon version gets all three - a top, a thong, a bracelet, and a leg ring in the colorway shown.

Chiffon keeps the set light and slightly sheer, closer to lingerie than to costume satin, which suits private wear better than a party hall. The bracelet and leg ring are small pieces with outsized effect; they break up the silhouette and give the camera something to catch.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: top, thong, bracelet, leg ring
  • Style: bunny girl uniform
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

One size across 40-60 kg. Add stockings if the look needs more coverage, leave them off if it does not.
19045.short: Chiffon bunny girl uniform set with top, thong, bracelet and leg ring, one size for 40-60 kg.
19045.tkd_title: Bunny Girl Uniform Set, 4 Pieces | RoseToys
19045.tkd_desc: Chiffon bunny girl set with top, thong, bracelet and leg ring, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, four-piece lingerie uniform.

19055.desc:
Five pieces make this maid set read as a costume rather than a lingerie set: headgear, neck ring, bra, thong, and the apron that does the actual work of saying maid. Chiffon throughout, in the colorway shown.

The apron is the anchor. Over a bra and thong it creates the servant silhouette from the front while leaving the back mostly bare - a structural trick heavier fabrics cannot pull off. The neck ring adds the formality that separates maid from generic lingerie, and the headgear finishes it.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: headgear, neck ring, bra, thong, apron
  • Style: maid servant, midnight glamour
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Sized 40-60 kg. Wear it as a complete costume or drop the headgear and neck ring for a simpler bedroom set.
19055.short: Five-piece chiffon maid servant set with apron, headgear, neck ring, bra and thong, one size for 40-60 kg.
19055.tkd_title: Midnight Maid Servant Costume Set | RoseToys
19055.tkd_desc: Chiffon maid servant costume with apron, headgear, neck ring, bra and thong. Five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.
